summary: Full backend + frontend verification of REAL ElevenLabs Scribe v2 Realtime integration in ClassOS. Backend: rewrote /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py for the current API (title/subject schema) — 19 pytest cases covering health, session lifecycle, scribe-token security (200 real+live / 400 demo / 409 after end / 404 unknown), API-key non-leakage, transcript store+dedup+ordering+empty-text, and error handling — ALL 19 PASSED. Frontend: DROVE REAL SPEECH AUDIO into the mic by overriding navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia with a WebAudio MediaStreamDestination looping /app/tests/fake_speech_48k.wav (temporarily served from frontend/public, since the harness cannot set Chromium launch args). Result: genuine ElevenLabs transcription confirmed — partial text streamed live and matched the spoken WAV content ('The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog. This is a live class transcription test. One two three four five.'), committed segments appended in chronological order, partial rendered italic + muted (fontStyle:italic, rgb(148,163,184)) vs committed normal dark (rgb(30,41,59)), auto-scroll pinned to bottom (verified deterministically), committed chunks persisted to MongoDB matching UI text exactly with unique increasing seqs. Also verified: DEMO separation (zero scribe-token/transcript network calls, live-status 'SIMULATED DEMO', results-mode 'Simulated Demo'), mic-denied honest error screen + retry back to start, forced 503 token failure -> 'Transcription unavailable' + Retry button that successfully recovered to Listening, and End Class cleanup (status=complete, transcript count identical immediately after End and +6s later = no recording continues). NO hardcoded/simulated transcript text found in Real Mode.

minor.issue: No session-status guard: the endpoint will happily store chunks for a session whose status is 'processing' or 'complete'. The frontend correctly stops posting after End (verified), but a stale/replayed client could append chunks to a finalized session. Consider rejecting with 409 when status != 'live'.
Still no state-transition validation (carried over from iteration 1): 'end' can be replayed on an already-complete session and reset it to 'processing'; 'finalize' can skip 'end'.
Returns 200 instead of 201 for resource creation (cosmetic REST nit).
Endpoint no longer exists (404). Expected per the current schema change, but the review request still listed it — confirming removal is intentional. No key leakage.

integration_issues.flow: End Class while a partial transcript is still pending
integration_issues.issue: MEDIUM/data-loss: ElevenLabs VAD did not emit its first committed segment until ~34s of continuous speech. handleEndClick calls scribe.disconnect() immediately with no flush/final-commit, so any speech still sitting in the un-committed partial buffer is silently discarded. Reproduced: a ~9s real session ended with 'Listening · microphone active' and 0 persisted chunks even though audio was being captured. Consider awaiting a final commit (or scribe's flush/commit API) before disconnecting, or persisting the last partial as a final chunk on End.

issues: The inner scroll region is capped at max-h-[240px] while the parent white card is flex-1 and grows to ~370px+, so a long transcript scrolls inside a small window with a large blank white area beneath it. Let the scroll region fill the card (flex-1 + min-h-0) instead of a fixed max-height.

Partial text accumulates unbounded while VAD waits to commit (observed 250+ characters / ~30s in one partial). Once the card overflows this is handled by auto-scroll, but consider truncating/windowing very long partials.

action_items: Flush/commit pending partial transcript before scribe.disconnect() in LiveClassReal.handleEndClick so trailing speech is not lost (MEDIUM).
Make the transcript scroll region fill its card (flex-1 min-h-0) instead of max-h-[240px] to remove the dead white space (LOW).
Optionally reject POST /transcript with 409 when session status != 'live' (LOW).
critical_code_review_comments: LiveClassReal.jsx: the mount useEffect's cleanup closes over `scribe` from the first render (stale closure) and the dependency array is disabled. It worked in all tests (disconnect on unmount confirmed by the no-new-chunks-after-End check), but store the hook object in a ref to make unmount cleanup robust.
LiveClassReal.jsx: postTranscriptChunk(...).catch(() => {}) swallows persistence failures silently — a dropped chunk would never surface to the user. Log it or surface a subtle 'not saved' indicator.
server.py: scribe_token correctly logs only type(e).__name__ and never echoes the key; verified no 'sk_' pattern in any response body.

server.py add_transcript_chunk uses $setOnInsert + upsert, which is the correct idempotent dedup; unique index on (session_id, seq) confirmed working (repeat POST with different text returns stored:false and preserves the original text).

success_rate.frontend: 100% of listed scenarios verified; 1 medium integration gap found (partial not flushed on End)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend suite: cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/backend_test.py -v. To DRIVE real speech through the mic without Chromium launch args: copy /app/tests/fake_speech_48k.wav into /app/frontend/public/, then page.add_init_script overriding navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia to return a MediaStreamAudioDestinationNode stream from an AudioBufferSourceNode (loop=true) decoding fetch('/test_fake_speech.wav'); also call context.grant_permissions(['microphone']). Real ElevenLabs partials appear within ~2s; first VAD commit takes ~34s of continuous speech, so budget 40-75s to observe committed segments. Delete the wav from public/ afterwards. Transcript scroll container selector: '[data-testid="transcript-area"] div.overflow-y-auto'. Force the 'Transcription unavailable' state by page.route-ing '**/api/sessions/*/scribe-token' to a 503.
rca_of_the_issue: Trailing-speech loss on End Class: ElevenLabs CommitStrategy.VAD only emits onCommittedTranscript after it detects an utterance boundary; with continuous speech the first commit came ~34s in. LiveClassReal.handleEndClick calls scribe.disconnect() synchronously and only committed chunks are ever POSTed, so the entire pending partial buffer is dropped. Mitigation: request a final commit/flush (or persist the current partial as the last chunk with the next seq) before disconnect. Everything else in the feature set behaved exactly as specified, including no post-End recording and complete demo/real isolation.
